{
  "dataset_name": "house_16h",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "p1_log_position",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled position of P1 within the fold observed P1 range; compresses very large counts into a 0-1 scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces leverage from extreme P1 values while keeping monotonic ordering for a linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(P1) - np.log1p(2.0)) / (np.log1p(1585577.0) - np.log1p(2.0)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p_core_share_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted centered projection of dense P shares P5p1, P15p1, and P16p2, clipped to 0-1.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "p_share_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds an approximate linear projection of high-prevalence P components, useful when small coordinated shifts matter.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.5 + 0.07 * ((P5p1 - 0.4830143763) / 0.0322394918) + 0.07 * ((P15p1 - 0.8514203719) / 0.0793356978) + 0.07 * ((P16p2 - 0.7168443623) / 0.0864099429), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p_sparse_share_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite severity of sparse P shares P6p2, P15p3, P18p2, and P27p4 scaled by observed upper endpoints.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_share_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts several low-frequency spikes into one smooth severity coordinate, reducing reliance on many separate thresholds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.25 * P6p2 + 0.25 * (P15p3 / 0.840351) + 0.25 * (P18p2 / 0.086957) + 0.25 * (P27p4 / 0.363636), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p_mid_band_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average normalized intensity of medium-frequency P components P11p4 and P14p9.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "p_band_intensity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures middle-band P variation as a single bounded coordinate with stable scaling.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.5 * (P11p4 / 0.836983) + 0.5 * (P14p9 / 0.5), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p15_internal_contrast",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio-like contrast between P15p3 and P15p1; high values indicate the smaller P15 component is large relative to the dominant P15 component.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "within_code_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Exposes within-group imbalance in a form that is nearly linear after bounding.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(P15p3 / (P15p1 + P15p3 + 0.000001), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p16_vs_p15_gap_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Centered score for the gap P16p2 - P15p1, shifted and clipped to a bounded scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "proportion_contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a signed contrast transformed onto a common scale, helping the margin use relative differences.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((P16p2 - P15p1 + 0.742201) / 1.583807, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h10_shortfall_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square-root shortfall of H10p1 from its upper endpoint, scaled by the fold observed span.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "ceiling_shortfall",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Turns a near-ceiling variable into a continuous deficit measure that spreads values away from saturation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.sqrt(np.clip((1.0 - H10p1) / (1.0 - 0.003257), 0.0, 1.0)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h_sparse_pressure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted severity of H2p2, H8p2, and H18pA after scaling each by its observed upper endpoint.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "h_share_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates several H-side pressure indicators into one robust weighted composite.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.4 * (H2p2 / 0.975177) + 0.3 * H8p2 + 0.3 * H18pA, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h40_h13_balance_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite of H40p4 midrange balance and H13p1 intensity on a bounded 0-1 scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "h_balance_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a bounded nonlinear projection of H40 midrange balance and H13 level for direct margin use.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.5 * (4.0 * H40p4 * (1.0 - H40p4)) + 0.5 * H13p1, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cross_p_h_sparse_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square-root interaction between sparse P burden and H pressure, normalized to a bounded scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "cross_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a smooth interaction term so coordinated P and H sparsity can affect the margin linearly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.sqrt(np.clip(0.25 * P6p2 + 0.25 * (P15p3 / 0.840351) + 0.25 * (P18p2 / 0.086957) + 0.25 * (P27p4 / 0.363636), 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(0.4 * (H2p2 / 0.975177) + 0.3 * H8p2 + 0.3 * H18pA, 0.0, 1.0)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "profile_coherence_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "0-1 semantic score for how coherently the P and H proportions vary together in a row, considering fold ranges; 0 means many isolated extremes, 1 means a smooth mutually consistent profile.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_coherence",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a compact nonlinear assessment of cross-column consistency that a linear margin can use directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "distributional_atypicality_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "0-1 semantic severity score for unusual multivariate shape compared with fold summaries; 0 means ordinary across most columns, 1 means highly atypical across several columns.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_atypicality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interpretable anomaly-like coordinate, helping margins respond to rare but coherent patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
